# Job Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 416v

---

**2:1** And-it-was the-day, and-came the-sons of-God [benei ha-elohim] to-present-themselves upon YHWH, and-came also the-Adversary [ha-satan] in-their-midst to-present-himself upon YHWH.

**2:2** And-said YHWH to the-Adversary, "From-where this you-come [tavo]?" And-answered the-Adversary YHWH and-said, "From-roaming [mi-shut] in-the-earth and-from-walking-about [me-hithalekh] in-it."

**2:3** And-said YHWH to the-Adversary, "Have-you-set your-heart upon my-servant Iyyov? For there-is-none like-him in-the-earth — a-man blameless [tam] and-upright [yashar], fearing God and-turning-away from-evil. And-still he-holds-fast [machaziq] to-his-integrity [tummatoh], though-you-incited-me [vattesiteniy] against-him to-swallow-him-up [levallo] without-cause [chinam]."

**2:4** And-answered the-Adversary YHWH and-said, "Skin for [be'ad] skin, and-all that a-man has he-will-give for [be'ad] his-life [nafsho]. **2:5** But stretch-out [shelach] now your-hand and-touch [nega] his-bone [atsmo] and-his-flesh [besaro] — surely [im lo] to your-face he-will-bless-you [yevarekekha]."

**2:6** And-said YHWH to the-Adversary, "Behold, he [is] in-your-hand; only [akh] his-life [nafsho] preserve [shemor]."

**2:7** And-went-out the-Adversary from-the-presence of-YHWH, and-struck [vayakh] Iyyov with-sores [bi-shechiyn] evil [ra] from-the-sole of-his-foot [kaf raglo] unto his-crown [qodqodo].

**2:8** And-he-took to-him a-potsherd [cheres] to-scrape-himself [lehitgared] with-it, and-he [was] sitting in-the-midst of-the-ashes [ha-efer].

**2:9** And-said to-him his-wife [ishto], "Still you-hold-fast [machaziq] to-your-integrity [tummatekha]? Bless [barekh] God and-die [vamut]."

**2:10** And-he-said to-her, "As-speaks one of-the-foolish-women [ha-nevalot] you-speak. Indeed [gam], shall-we-receive [neqabbel] good [ha-tov] from God and-evil [ha-ra] shall-we-not receive?" In-all this Iyyov did-not sin with-his-lips [bi-sfatav].

**2:11** And-heard the-three friends [re'ei] of-Iyyov all the-evil that had-come upon-him, and-they-came each from-his-place: Elifaz [Eliphaz] the-Teimanite [ha-Teimaniy], and-Bildad the-Shuchite [ha-Shuchiy], and-Tsofar [Zophar] the-Naamathite [ha-Na'amatiy]; and-they-appointed-together [vayivva'adu] to-come to-grieve-with-him [lanuud lo] and-to-comfort-him [ulenachamo].

**2:12** And-they-lifted their-eyes from-afar [me-rachoq] and-did-not recognize-him [lo hikiruhu]; and-they-lifted their-voice and-wept [vayivku], and-tore each his-robe [me'ilo], and-sprinkled [vayizrequ] dust [afar] upon their-heads toward-the-heavens [ha-shamayemah].

**2:13** And-they-sat with-him on-the-ground [la-arets] seven days [shiv'at yamim] and-seven nights [shiv'at leilot], and-none spoke [dover] a-word [davar] to-him, for they-saw that the-pain [ha-ke'ev] was very great [gadol me'od].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.3 — "you incited me":** The verb *vattesiteniy* (from *sut*, to incite) is remarkable — YHWH acknowledges that the Adversary provoked him to act against Iyyov "without cause" (*chinam*), the same word used of Iyyov's gratuitous piety in 1:9.

**v.4 — "Skin for skin":** This proverbial expression (*or be'ad or*) is unique in the Hebrew Bible. Its precise meaning is debated — likely "a man will trade one skin (another's suffering) to save his own skin (life)."

**v.9 — "Bless God and die":** Again the *barakh* euphemism. The wife uses YHWH's own description of Iyyov's integrity (*tummatekha*) and turns it into an accusation — why hold fast to something that brings only suffering?

---
*— EMET*
